notes.title: Gori - Twitch Integration Patch 1.0.169
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37644815/b3f07dd6bb71d41ea43d3d9e22cc024ea96ebd08.jpg

Hey everyone! A brand new patch is available to download for Gori which contains a whole host of bug fixes and some new features. The biggest amongst these is some shiny Twitch integration that allows streamers to bring their chat into the game and...well...slay them - we'll go through those specifically first and then onto the rest of the patch!

The Steam Scream Fest

Today the Steam Scream Fest kicks off.... Now, actually (cheers UK time zone change) - meaning you can get a ridiculous 30% off the game! That's right - for little over £10 you can get the greatest game of 2024 released about a cat that rides hoverboards. Bonkers.

If you haven't picked up Gori yet (we get it, that wishlist backlog is FULL) now is the perfect time to treat yourself  - or to tell your friends you know of this game they are gonna LOVE (tell them about the meow button)

Speaking of treats. We have plenty more to come for you this week, so keep your eyes peeled to the news blog here tomorrow!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299690/Gori_Cuddly_Carnage/

Twitch Integration

We've added the ability for your chat to support you through free custom commands and bits through some radical Twitch features - including :

1 - Viewers type !Join to have their name attached to an enemy on spawn then a celebratory message is displayed when you kill them!

2 - Gifts are placed throughout each level - when you attack one, anyone who has donated bits or used the custom command is ranked and displayed - and you'll get health, boost juice or in game credits depending on what you need, as well as a snazzy hat that protects you from damage!

3 - When you die, viewers can spam the custom command to fill up the meter and bring you back to life!

[previewyoutube=4n8ugJVFYkA;full][/previewyoutube]

You'll need to enable the feature from the options menu and set up custom commands to do this - You can find a more in depth guide on how this all operates by checking out our Twitch FAQ page:

https://gori.wtf/twitch-integration/



On October 31st the Free Halloween update will be going live for everyone on all platforms - letting Gori get into the spooky spirit covering the menus with frightful decorations, and also adding a new skin to the game that lets you become what the Adorable Army are afraid of at night.

[previewyoutube=7cug505uzZs;full][/previewyoutube]

The Special Halloween Skin pack comes free with the update - featuring a glow in the dark outfit for Gori, a spooky shield skin, and a hellish new paint job for F.R.A.N.K - complete with Ouija board (hoping to summon more unicorns to slay no doubt!)

On top of the the cosmetic update and new skin, we've also added full Mandarin VO support for the Chinese fans out there!

 Let's Get Physical!

On top of this, to celebrate National Cat Day (every day, if you ask cats) the physical editions of Gori are now out on Ps5! featuring a host of sweet goodies inside for the collectors out there (as well as the chance to find a golden ticket and win your very own F.R.A.N.K board - doesnt swear unfortunately)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37644815/ec9d8c046a053a0118e878963365e49e06fb1b45.jpg

You can order yours now from :

The Wired Store for those in GB : https://wired.gg/GoriPS5
Amazon for US residents : http://a.co/d/2MHCEGX
Amazon for EU: http://amzn.eu/d/itf2ky9
Amazonfor GB: http://amzn.eu/d/20ZoBVt

Patch Notes

This patch brings more than just some new toys for content creators though!

Controls

 Added ability to rebind movement keys on PC  
 Button prompts in loading screen now displays latest device used on PC
 Moving mouse in option menus now changes layout to keyboard on PC
 Players can now select controller glyphs style in the options menu
 Added support for DualSense™ for all PC platforms 
 Fixed flipped stick and invert axes settings


Visuals

 Added 90 frame rate limit option
 HDR now works correctly on PC platforms for screen above 1000nits brightness
 Added option to graphics menu to lock vertical FOV


Gameplay

 Time medal stats in level 7 is tweaked
 Cuddly Carnage difficulty now available if ever completed level 8 on any save slot
 Twitch Integration added


Bug Fixes

 Player no longer gets stuck when performing a Tankkill immediatly after a finisher
 Player will no longer be able to die right after using extra life
 Fixed issue with cut scene skipping without input
 Trigger buttons in photomode now display correctly on Steamdeck
 Fixed Level 6 Challenge 1 Displaying wrong damage amount
 Fixed camera twitch when using Grenade shot
 Updates grenade UI icon when changing to the original in upgrade booth
 No double Gori in photomode when using eggporter
 Player now stops movement during supershot charge when grinding
 Instability issues in cutscenes fixed
 Boss is now vulnerable for a longer time on highest difficulty
 Collision issues with mushroom platforms in level 7 fixed
 Added collision in level 4 challenge to prevent cheating
 Legend outfit will save when final level is complete
 Fixed Frank missing and crash after resurrect
 Fixed player dying immediately after using Extra life
 Fixed Alt+Tab during skip cut scene query locking the game 
 Fixed Main Menu vanishing after choosing no on apply graphics query
 Fixed grinds not refueling after supershot
 Fixed too fast turning when jumping with evade and boost  
 Fixed target lock not locking on nearest visible enemy  
 Demonicorns break grass in level 2 to prevent getting stuck
 Fixed unicorn suddenly vanishing
 Fixed Slash/Bash animation getting locked 
 Pause game on Steam overlay activated


As always thank you for your feedback and suggestions, we are continuing to monitor and work through them as we go! 

We hope you enjoy the new features added to Gori - and just a quick heads up that if you HAVEN'T picked up the game yet - HOLD FIRE! There's a sale launching on Monday that would be a great time to pick it up :) (Or if you already have, tell your friends!)

This isn't the only update that you'll be receiving in October however - keep your eyes peeled next week for a spooky treat...

Gary - Wired Productions

notes.title: Gori Patch 1.0.138 Now Live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37644815/31b5d24bcb3614fcf57dadc7930b61c46a80a52c.jpg

Hey everyone! 

Earlier this week we told you that there was a brand new patch incoming, and we're pleased to announce, It's here! It features a whole host of bug fixes - as well as some new shiny things for you all, let's dive in!

Steam Community Items 

First of all, we finally have our Steam community assets out in the wild, you can use your hard earned Steam points to grab some sweet Gori themed digital Swag!

- Trading Cards
- Profile Backgrounds
- Point Items (such as avatars, and borders)
- Emotes
- Badges

All available for you to dress up your profile and share your love of Gori / hatred of the Adorable Army! Awesome!

Updated Photo Mode

We love photo modes, we love seeing everything you create with photo mode. On launch one of the most requested features was to let Gori change his expression whilst taking photo's - we're happy to announce that now you can do just that! 

Both Gori and Frank can have their faces changed to a set number of expressions to really give whatever carnage you are snapping the appropriate response from our heroes (though we still standby the fact that cool cats don't look at explosions)

We'll be running a competition next week to see who can produce the most badass usage of the new poses, we can't wait to see what you come up with!

General Patch Notes

Alright now we get tot he (unicorn) meat of the patch - plenty of fixes based on your feedback - be sure to update your game to enjoy the best possible experience!

Bug Fixes
- Boss in level 7 can no longer get stuck in air
- Level 2 boss resets its stage when player is using extra life in the final phase
- Fixed supershot launching player outside skybox (Gori will no longer go to T H E V O I D)
- Fixed player falling through floor on tankkills
- Fixed player running a finisher inside dollhouse and getting stuck
- Slime chase sequences in level 3 is no longer skippable by pressing against the door
- Player stuck in FRANK's channel in television by falling into mouth is now fixed
- Prevented crash from happening when reloading checkpoint during character introduction
- Comicbook overlay not able to persist after skipping comicbook cutscene
- Prevented player from getting trapped under Goldfin during level combats
- Fixed random crash on pressing play on Epic Games Store
- Fixed collision in toy booth area in level 1
- Fixed savefile corruption bug with save data duplicating

Balancing CHanges 
- Increased amount of fuel gain per kill in harder difficulties
- Targeting system won't pick enemies off screen during chase sequences
- Gameplay improvements made to the laser ceiling challenge in level 2
- Spawnpoint added in level 2 outside the Diamond Dungeon machine
- Checkpoint in start of level 5 added
- Player will have access to all items in the toybooth in the first level when replaying it
- Added more balloons to level 4 (hurray!)
- Level 4 elevator doors open sooner
- Ladybug JR can't be defeated by grinding on another grindspline
- Ladybug JR doesn't charge towards Gori if it's to far away anymore
- Blender is now active during the Goldfin-challenge in level 7
- Player is no longer able to get stuck in Ladybug JR when it spawns
- Player won't lock after using grenadeshot straight after certain cutscenes

Unlockables
- "Legendary Medallist" achievement now unlocks as intended
- "Legend" outfit will now always unlock after final level is completed

Performance
- The amount of ducks in level 6 is not more in lower FPS anymore
- Instability issues fixed

Misc
- Frank is now silent in level 7 when he's not present
- Updated "New game" spelling in French language
- Several collision related issues fixed
- Photo mode depth of field now affect arcade machine screens
- Level 5 courtyard no longer streamed out when backtracking
- Added 4 characters to the character viewer
- Bleeps are back in stock! Players can now reinstall the censorship for F.R.A.N.K
- Collision added to "My Little Atom-Cleaver"
- Added Gori facial expressions in photomode
- *SPOILER BOSS* now looks damaged in ending cutscene
- Photomode is now available in cutscenes
- Health and fuelbars are now updated instant visually when upgrading
- Photomode now keeps custom settings
- Camera will now blend smoother in some places

Phew, that was a lot!
Thank you all for your feedback, your bug reports here, on socials and Discord, and of course - for playing the game!

We'll keep an eye on the forums for any additional issues once the patch is live - so if something isn't behaving, let us know!

That's gonna do it for today, we hoper you enjoy the new photomode features - please share all your creations with us all over the internet - and once again, keep your eyes peeled, we've got one or two radical surprises in store to share with you!

As always, look after yourselves, please share the game with your friends if you think they'll like it, and don't forget to leave (honest!) reviews!

Have a great week!

| Angry Demon Twitter | Gori Twitter | Wired Facebook | Wired Twitter | Wired Youtube | Wired Discord | Wired Instagram | Wired Twitch  | Wired Reddit | Wired Imgur

notes.title: An important update on Gori
notes.notes:
Dear Gori: Cuddly Carnage Fans,

As you may have heard, Gori: Cuddly Carnage will be launching physically on 29th October for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch! In the US and ASIA this remains true and we can’t wait for more players to get their paws on Gori. However, we have an important update regarding availability in the UK and EU.

Due to recent challenges in the retail landscape, including the closure of many brick-and-mortar outlets, we’ve faced difficulties ensuring widespread availability of our game. Despite our efforts, it has become unsustainable to maintain physical stock in traditional retail channels. Many stores primarily focus on AAA titles, leaving limited space for indie AA games like ours.

Therefore, starting today, we have made the decision to take control and, going forward, we will only make the PEGI version of our games available exclusively via our store. We’re pleased to announce that Gori: Cuddly Carnage for PlayStation 5 can be pre-ordered today, and we have begun manufacturing for the 29th October release.

For the PS4 and Nintendo Switch versions of Gori: Cuddly Carnage, we need to gauge interest first. We don’t want to take pre-orders and risk not fulfilling them or make you wait several months whilst we hold your money. By first seeing what interest there is in these editions, we’ll then decide if it’s sustainable and viable to produce PEGI versions for these formats.

We believe in the importance of a physical strategy for our game, but it must be sustainable in today’s market conditions. This shift will allow us to better serve our community, and we thank you for your understanding and continued support.

Again, our orders and editions in the US and ASIA are completely unaffected.

You can pre-order, or register your interest for these editions today, direct from the Wired Store: https://shop.wiredproductions.com/collections/coming-soon

Team Wired

notes.title: News Update 08/31
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! =D
Victor from Angry Demon Studio here to bring you people some awesome news!
The production of Gori: Cuddly Carnage is at 100% and we’re making great progress. We are taking a lot of your feedback into consideration, remaking things that don’t work and improving things to MAX out the experience! xD We want Gori: Cuddly Carnage to be as good as we can make it, and your feedback helps tremendously!
We don’t want to give too much away on what we are making at the moment… But a small peek maybe? ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37644815/e1067dca27c163368158b99f241e85ee6bcc5c0f.png

We are not fully sure how these new “Demoicorns” will play out in game yet, if we replace the old Unicorns or mix them in as bigger units. We’ll see =P we will do some tests with it before you people get your hands on it, we just stepped out of the concept face and into 3D so ;) it’s still very early on.
This is ofc just a small taste of what’s to come ;) As you might have seen in a previous post we have a list of features / things small and big we need to fix and add that will come to the game at it’s full release. We got an early draft of the photomode working for example ;).
 
If you want some more in depth cool behind the scenes stuff on current and previous things with Gori: Cuddly Carnage, Apsulov: End of Gods and Unforgiving: A northern Hymn. And also want to support us and help the development of our games, then consider joining our patreon.
https://www.patreon.com/AngryDemonStudio
Or donate to us on Ko-fi if Behind the Scenes are not your thing and you purely want to support us  ;)
https://ko-fi.com/angrydemonstudio
Thank you all for your continued support! We love what we do and you people make it even more awesome!
And as a small reminder we have a Discord too where you can chat and hang with us and the rest of our community. --> https://discord.com/invite/nM9xXFD
For now I return into our demon dev cave to make some more 3D stuff xD. I’ll try to emerge a little more to bring you people some news and updates from now on though, so you people know whats happening and that we are not standing still =P. And I'll try to keep it spoiler free xD.

Anyhow…. that's it for now! Until next time everyone, have an amazing day/week/month! xD
